design_contract.source_of_truth: Bang scp_events durable: id BIGSERIAL, channel TEXT, payload JSONB, created_at TIMESTAMPTZ, delivered_at TIMESTAMPTZ NULLABLE, correlation_id TEXT, attempts BIGINT, dead BOOLEAN; index (channel,id) + partial index undelivered
design_contract.notify_role: NOTIFY (pg_notify(channel, event_id) cung transaction voi INSERT) CHI la chuong wake-up de poll som hon; mat NOTIFY khong mat event — replay_undelivered() hoac cursor la duong phuc hoi
design_contract.delivery_semantics: at-least-once per subscriber cursor; handler phai idempotent; delivered_at la ack cap channel (it nhat 1 subscriber da xu ly); fan-out dung cursor rieng
design_contract.failure_semantics: handler exception -> log traceback + KHONG mark delivered + attempts+1 + cursor dung lai (retry lan sau, in-order bounded head-of-line); du max_attempts (default 3) -> dead=TRUE + log CRITICAL + cursor tro qua (poison guard, khong loop vo han)
design_contract.fail_closed: publish raise moi loi (khong nuot); connection publish duoc rollback cleanup roi re-raise; listen/poll connection chet -> raise loudly (recovery = restart + replay, khong silent reconnect)
